scenes.headline: How FlashAttention-3 keeps every unit on the chip busy
scenes.sub: Warp specialization, pingpong overlap and FP8, read from the Hopper source.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Foxglove! FlashAttention-3 keeps version two's tiling. What's new is a schedule that keeps every unit on the chip busy at once.

scenes.text: FlashAttention-3 is mostly a schedule, not an algorithm: split warpgroups by job so the loader, the tensor cores and the exponential unit stop taking turns.
scenes.say: The idea: give each warpgroup one job, so the loader, the tensor cores and the exponential unit stop taking turns.

steps.say: Tiles stream from HBM into shared memory through the TMA, a copy engine that runs on its own.

steps.note: memory is off the critical path
steps.say: A producer warpgroup only issues those loads, so memory drops off the critical path.
A consumer does the maths: multiply, softmax, multiply. Alone, the tensor cores and the exponential unit take turns.

steps.note: one in the softmax while the other is in the GEMM
steps.say: So a second consumer is staggered by a barrier. While one runs the softmax, the other multiplies. Nothing got faster; the units stopped taking turns.

scenes.title: Registers, spent to the boundary
scenes.say: Separate jobs also let warpgroups trade registers, the binding constraint on an attention kernel.

parts.note: the producer: 24 registers, because TMA computes addresses
parts.say: With the TMA computing addresses, the producer keeps just twenty-four per thread.
Each consumer takes two hundred and forty. Without the TMA, the producer needs forty, and each consumer gives up eight.
Ninety-eight point four percent of the register file. These are the largest allocations that fit.

left.title: FP16 / BF16 kernel
items: V used as stored, no transpose
left.say: The sixteen-bit kernel runs forward and backward, and uses V as stored.

right.title: FP8 kernel
items: Scales per batch and per head
right.say: FP8 is a separate compilation: forward only, V transposed in shared memory, and a scale per head to keep it accurate.

scenes.text: On hardware with independent async units, attention speed depends on whether those units are busy at the same time.

recap: A producer loads; consumers do the maths
Two consumers pingpong GEMM against softmax
scenes.say: To recap: a producer loads, two consumers pingpong, and every register is spent.
